title: Highlight fenced code blocks by language
close_reason: hl.rs, hooked into the code panel, in 128e07c

notes.author: Jack Roddy/42dfd115
notes.text: Design, proposed 2026-10-09: a lexical highlighter, not a grammar. Four token classes per language (comment, string, number, keyword) for rust, python, sh, json, toml, yaml and diff; anything else renders unstyled on a dim background. syntect was considered and rejected for binary size and build time; it could come later behind a cargo feature.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/42dfd115
notes.text: Decided 2026-10-09: lexical highlighting, no syntect, for now.
